name: AVT Natural Products Ltd
about: AVT Natural Products Limited is a part of the A.V. Thomas Group. The Company is engaged in the business of manufacturing plant-based extracts and natural ingredients solutions for the food, beverage, animal nutrition and nutraceutical industries of the world. [1]
keyPoints: Products Segments:  The company operates in the business segment of Food & Feed Ingredients from Natural Raw materials. [1]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 22.6%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.00% over past five years.
